Dueling is a 3v3 fair competitive mode where your combat attributes will be balanced (character stats are equalized, while equipment sets and tuning effects can be customized in the slot balance. Mystic Skills are set at Tier 6 with 15 segments, and Inner Way is at Tier 6. If you have already mastered Mystic Skill variations, their effects in battle will match those outside; otherwise, default effects will apply.). You can either queue solo or form a 3-player team. In Dueling, you can use up to 20 arrows, cannot revive teammates, and healing effects are reduced by 70%. After a certain time in combat, player damage increases while healing effects further decrease.  

Most player skills can be countered with Deflection. Armor-Breaking Mystic Skills not only ignore Deflection but also perform better against targets guarding or using Deflection, though they can be interrupted by any skill. Using Deflection consumes Stamina, while executing a finisher restores it.  

Player skills (including Mystic Skills and charged attacks) can interrupt light/heavy attacks, but not vice versa. The control-break skill "Serene Breeze" can be used while under attack or crowd control, and mastering it can turn the tide.  

Mobile and PC platforms have separate matchmaking pools. For team matchmaking: the system checks all members' device types. If any PC player is detected, the team enters the PC queue. If a mobile player engages in cross-platform account sharing or other anomalies after matchmaking, they will be placed in the PC queue thereafter.  

Victory is awarded to the team that defeats all opponents within the time limit. If time runs out, the winner is determined by:  
1. The team with more surviving players wins.  
2. If tied, the team with higher total damage wins.  
3. If still tied, the team with higher total healing wins.

The Hundred Trades League is divided into 3 phases:
#YPreparation Period#E: #GSeptember 26th to October 3rd#E. The Hundred Trades War enters a new season, and eligible trades will automatically qualify for the league. All trades will be grouped, with a maximum of 200 trades assigned to the same group.

#YPlacement Matches#E: #GOctober 4th to October 12th#E. Placement matches will be held every Saturday and Sunday at 20:30, one match per day, lasting for 2 weeks. Final groupings will be determined based on placement match results.
Top 16: Sage Group
17th~32nd: Deity Group
33rd~48th: Hero Group
Other trades: Shadow Group

#YRegular Season#E: #GOctober 18th to December 21st#E. The Hundred Trades War enters the regular season phase, with matches conducted according to groupings. Each round lasts 2 weeks, with the bottom 4 in each group demoted to the next lower group. The top 4 in each group will be promoted to the higher group. If a trade disbands, vacancies will be filled based on rankings.

The league will adopt the #YSwiss System#E format, matching opponents based on trade performance. Final rankings will be determined by #Ywins, points, and prosperity#E in that order. Prosperity is only updated #Yat the end of each match#E.
